name: Touchstone Primer (Thí Kim Quyết)
notes: Chân Kim Các NO-LEAN element-free outer gate method (names: []). Passives sized for Yellow tier (8.0 W of 8): thần thức, accuracy, resistance penetration and linh lực regeneration.
concept: The apprentice assayer's method. It draws no element: it trains the cultivator's spirit sense (thần thức) to feel the weight and purity of whatever they touch, as a streak on a touchstone shows the gold. Qi is gathered from the cultivator's own root, whatever it is, and spent on sense rather than force. In a fight the holder reads the foe and finds where they are weakest.
lore: The founders' teaching for the boys and girls of Song Kiều who come to sweep the assay floor. An apprentice is not taught to weigh until they can tell nine silvers apart with their eyes shut.

name: True Gold Canon (Chân Kim Kinh)

effects.name: True Gold Does Not Fear the Furnace
effects.rule: Each buff stack you strip from the foe, and each ward share your Assay strips, restores 1.5 % of your maximum linh lực and adds one Part the Dross stack.

notes: Chân Kim Các NO-LEAN element-free inner gate method (names: []). Depth passives (b3, b5) kept verbatim (14.2 W of 16); Profound bonus than_thuc_pct 10 added. Passive art True Gold Does Not Fear the Furnace (d31, L4) wired via Stage 6 technique-effects.
concept: From the proverb: true gold does not fear the furnace (chân kim bất phạ hỏa luyện). The cultivator refines their own qi by testing it, layer by layer, against the furnace of their spirit until only the true part is left; the method takes any root and asks only for a steady soul. In a fight it assays the foe: wards, buffs and borrowed strength are shown for what they are and burned off.
lore: Written down by Tưởng Bách Luyện and Hạng Thử Kim in the first decade of the house (V127), from the assayers' craft of the Pivot's mint at Bạch Ngân, where both had worked.

name: Hundred Refinings (Bách Luyện Pháp)
notes: Chân Kim Các NO-LEAN element-free secret refining method (names: []). Profound bonus (attack_pct 8) and passives (14.2 W of 16) sized for Profound secret tier.
concept: The refiner's art: spirit ore is melted and parted a hundred times, each time by the refiner's spirit sense, until it is pure. It needs no element of the refiner's own; the furnace provides the heat. In a fight the holder parts a foe's strength from them a little at each hit.
lore: The head's own art, for which he is named. He has refined the Pivot's silver, the Dawn Charioteer (thien_xu items, 1168) and the smiths' ingots by it.
